query: Moss Inference X-Moss-Indexes moss_search billing retrievals

text: 3 retrievals are billed. The X-Moss-Indexes header makes one search before the model runs (one retrieval, however many indexes it names), and each moss_search call that an index answered is one more retrieval, however many indexes the tool names (two calls = 2). Total 1 + 2 = 3, at $0.50 per 1k retrievals (about $0.0015).
